tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi byin rlabs dang nyams su blang tshul bzhugs so// phan dang bde ba'i dbang phyug skye dgu'i skyabs/ /'gro 'di'i bde skyid nam yang nyams med par/ /lhag nas cho gas rab tu ston mdzad pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs pad gtsug na rgyal/ /'dir lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi byin rlabs ni/ gnas khang dben par mdun gyi stegs bu'i steng du rje btsun gyi chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdeng ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba ljang ser/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba bshams/ bgegs gtor gtong na de yang logs gcig tu bshams/ de nas slob dpon gyi skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed bde mchog gam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gang 'os la bya/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa shar dkar sogs/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa/ mdun gyi pad 'dab la nyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las tshogs bdag 'og g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las gri gug yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug gnyis pa na thod phreng / gsum pa na ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag

gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ g.yas kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma dang / 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo dbu skra dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng na mar sil le yod pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum khro bo'i rnam pa can/ mche ba nas tsam 'byung ba/ spyan g.yon gyis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad nam mkha' la gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi gri gug dpyi g.yas kyi steng na nar re brkyangs pa/ g.yon pa nam mkha' la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi'i thod pa'i nang na mar gsol pa/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo dang rnam snang gis brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba/ rus pa'i sna cha mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas mahā de ba mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas u ma de wa mnan pa/ mchan khung g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pa gcig tu bskyed/ rgyab kyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po gangs la nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas skyabs sbyin dang bcas pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ril ba bsnams pa/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/ dbu skra dpung pa'i steng na sil le yod pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa gcig tu bsgom/ g.yon ngos kyi pad 'dab la/ zla ba'i steng du taṃ yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu lang tsho dar la bab pa lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung ba/

spyi bor don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa gcig bsgom/ de thams cad kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum 'god/ de nas bla ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs nas dbus kyi bla ma la thim pas bla ma de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur/ mgon po'i thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa/ shar lho nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ de bzhin du rje btsun ma dang / spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma la yang ye shes pa spyan drangs la mdun bskyed kyi lha de dang de la thim par bsam/ de nas mchod pa byin brlab la/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wa re'i mthar ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid sogs dang / srin po'i gzugs kyis sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs dang / skyon gyis ma gos sogs dang / lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyi/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal dang kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol btab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis rgyun bshags sngon du btang nas/ 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i dbang de nyid rang gis kyang blang ba ni bdag 'jug go /de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la bgegs gtor btang la bgegs bskrad/ sems can thams cad kyi zhes sogs sems bskyed gsal btab la/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa rnams kyi thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i chos lha bzhi dril sgrub ces bya ba shin tu zab pa de yin/ de'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug gsol btab dang rgyun bshags sngar bshad pa bzhin bya/ dngos gzhi'i slad du khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ mdun bskyed kyi chos 'byung nang gi lha dang bcas pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug tu yer re byon pa'i dbus su zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes sogs sngar bzhin brjod/

mdun gyi pad 'dab la nyi gdan gyi steng du tshogs bdag mgo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du ye shes kyi mgon po/ g.yas kyi pad 'dab la nyi ma dang 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyab kyi pad 'dab la zla ba'i gdan steng du spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon ngos kyi pad 'dab la/ zla ba'i steng du rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'di rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul rnams sngar mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin gsal btab/ hūm̐ dang hrī la sogs pa 'dir mi dgos/ de nas dbus kyi bla ma de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgom la 'di gsung ba zhu/ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na mo saṃ ghā ya zhes gsol ba btab/ mgon po'i thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer dmar po me 'od lta bu 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ nad gdon thams cad zhal du dmar 'dzir 'dzir gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe ṭa big+nan bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ji ltar rigs pa brjod du gzhug de nas g.yas kyi rje btsun ma'i thugs kha'i sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dmar po babs gsang gnas nas thon/ khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus la bde chen gyi ye shes skyes par mos la sngags 'di gsung ba zhu/ oṃ badz+ra na ra kriṃ kriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ces pa'i yang na oṃ gsum ma tshar gsum re rjes bzlos byed du gzhug rgyun gyi thugs dam la tshar ci mang bzla ba yin/ de nas rgyab kyi pad 'dab la bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag g.yas pa'i ril ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs/ khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag bde ba chen po skyes par bsam nas 'di gsung ba zhu/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa man+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'am yang na yi ge drug pa lan ci rigs bzla ru gzhug de nas g.yon ngos kyi sgrol ma'i zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

khyed rang gi lus thams cad la thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag bde ba chen po skyes par bsam nas oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pa brjod du gzhug de nas pad 'dab la bzhugs pa'i lha bzhi dbus kyi bla ma la sib kyis thim/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ bla ma la thim pas bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin snang la rang bzhin med par gyur pa la gsol btab 'di gsung pa zhu/ na mo bud+dha ya zhes sogs sngar ltar brjod du gzhug de nas khyed rang gi lte ba'i gtum mo a thung las me 'bar rtsa dbu ma'i nang na yar song tshangs bug nas thon/ pad+ma'i lte ba na bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i sku la phog pas sku'i nang gi lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mer zhu/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang / bla ma'i sku'i byin rlabs thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang / na mo bud+dha ya sogs kyi mthar a bh+ya sha ya a brjod/ de bzhin du yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun tshangs bug nas zhugs/ mgrin pa dang snying khar sleb pa na gsung dang thugs kyi byin rlabs thob snyam pa dang / ngag dang yid kyi sgrib pa dag snyam pa dang / gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa byed du gzhug de gnyis re re la yang ḍā dril dang na mo bud+dha sogs sngar bzhin/ yang bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa khyed rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lte bar slebs pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi pa thob snyam pa'i mos pa byed du gzhug cing / ḍā dril dang sngar bzhin/ de nas chos 'byung de nyid nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song /

bla ma gdan dang bcas pa 'od du mer zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi bor nas zhugs mar thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par gyur te gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dbyings rig dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du 'jog pa zhu/ 'di ni do ha las/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin nyid du de bsam bya/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan zhi ba lhas/ thams cad nam mkha' 'dra ba ni/ /bdag 'dras yongs su bzung bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi dgongs don gyi lta ba 'di yin no/ /rjes gtso bos sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ de ltar bla ma la thog mar byin rlabs thob nas lha bzhi'i dril sgrub 'di rgyun du nyams su len na/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lhar bsgoms kyang rung / skyabs sems sngon du btang nas rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde bar shar zhing bde bar gnas pa/ 'od kyi rang bzhin can rtsa ba phra ba rang gi tshangs bug tu zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngar bshad pa bzhin dang / phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la rang rang gi gdan gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐ sogs las lha bzhi bskyed/ so so'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa rnams mdun bskyed bzhin bya/ de nas bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsgom la/ na mo bud+dha ya sogs kyi gsol btab nas bzung / lha bzhi so so'i sngags ci nus bzlas la dbang bzhi blang / mthar lta ba'i ngang du 'jog bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs dang bkra shis kyi 'phreng bas mtha' brtan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi lcags pho 'brug lo zla ba bdun pa'i nang du sngon gyi yig rnying la brten nas mdar grang chen du phyag len la bkod pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ//
